caption:
Your brain knows when you're lying on paper. "Repeat I am enough" when you don't believe it doesn't build confidence — it teaches your brain the journal can't be trusted. The Evidence Line replaces affirmations with proof. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#journaling #affirmations #overthinking #mentalhealth #arajournals
